title: Instantaneous speed at 2s
description: Essential: Correctly reads the instantaneous speed at t=2s from the table as 3 m/s.

title: Average acceleration (0-3s)
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the average acceleration over the first 3 seconds using a = (v₃ - v₀)/t₃, yielding 5/3 or 1.67 m/s².

title: Average speed (4th second)
description: Important: Correctly calculates the average speed during the 4th second using displacement over time: (x₄ - x₃)/1s.

title: Average acceleration (4th second)
description: Important: Correctly calculates the average acceleration during the 4th second using a = (v₄ - v₃)/1s.

title: Correct velocity reading
description: Important: Uses the correct velocity values from the table for all calculations (e.g., v₀, v₃, v₄).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Includes correct units (m/s, m/s²) with all final numerical answers.

title: Confusing speed and acceleration
description: Pitfall: Confuses average speed with average acceleration or uses incorrect definitions (e.g., average speed as (v₀+v_f)/2).

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly handles signs for acceleration or misinterprets the direction of motion from the data.
